name: ListTemplates
description: A collection of ListTemplate objects in a document, list gallery, or template.
remarks: Use the ListTemplates property with a Document, ListGallery, or Template object to return a ListTemplates collection. With a ListGallery object, the ListTemplates collection is the seven list formats for bulleted lists, numbered lists, and outline numbered lists. The following example displays a message with the level status (single or multiple-level) for each list template in the active document. Use the Add method to add a list template to the collection in the specified document or template. The following example adds a new list template to the active document and applies it to the selection. Use ListTemplates (Index), where Index is the name of a list template or an index number, to return a single list template in a document or template. The following example sets an object variable equal to a list template named "ListBullets" in the active document, and then formats the selection as the first level of that list template. Use ListTemplates (Index), where Index is a number 1 through 7, to return a single list template in a list gallery.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of list templates in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ListTemplates object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual ListTemplate object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([OutlineNumbered As Variant], [Name As Variant]) As ListTemplate
methods.description: Returns a ListTemplate object that represents a new list template.

parameters.name: OutlineNumbered
parameters.description: True to apply outline numbering to the new list template.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: An optional name used for linking the list template to a LISTNUM field. Use this name to index the list template in the collection.
